Market today: The Fed rate hike news is the real driver, spooking markets and hitting your concentrated tech/chip names hard. Expect more volatility.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.15%) and SPAL (-31.41%) are bleeding. QQQ (-1.39%) and SMH (-14.27%) are also underwater. SPY (2.68%) is your only green, but it's marked for attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on the leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and the broader tech indices (QQQ, SMH) for any signs of stabilization or further breakdown.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged book is taking a beating; focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming further if it breaks below its current price, given its leveraged nature and deep losses.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming if the price continues to fall, as it's also leveraged and decaying.
No new buys today - hold and watch
